description: This file defines data structures and functions for configuring and validating cell measurement parameters in a 5G NR network, including serving and neighbor cell configurations, as well as a formatter for displaying cell measurement configurations.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::ocucp::cell_meas_config>
classes.description: Formatter specialization for printing ocudu::ocucp::cell_meas_config objects

methods.name: is_complete
methods.description: Verifies that all required parameters in serving_cell_meas_config are set

methods.name: is_valid_configuration
methods.description: Validates the overall cell measurement manager configuration without requiring all cells to be complete
